messages:
Jules (Docs): Quick PR to consolidate Dedicated provisioning FAQs + add two ready-to-copy examples: tenant quota + autoscale. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Thanks — can we include a tiny terraform sample that reserves GPUs and an autoscale policy with cooldown? Customers ask for a minimal working example.

Jules (Docs): Yep. Also need clearer language on maintenance evictions. Current phrase 'may be paused' is vague.

Mina (Product): Replace with: 'Autoscaler will avoid placing new replicas on nodes under maintenance; existing replicas follow the maintenance eviction policy in SLA.'

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Adding TF snippet:
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "batch" {
  name = "batch-pool"
  region = "eu-central-1"
  gpu_count = 6
  isolation = "reserved"
}
resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "batch_scale" {
  pool_id = redwood_dedicated_pool.batch.id
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 12
  cooldown_seconds = 120
  target_utilization = 0.7
}
```

Owen (DevEx): I'll add NodeJS SDK and CLI snippets for quota migration. NodeJS example: `await client.pools.create({name:'tenant-a', gpus:2, isolation:'shared', quotas:{tokens_per_minute:1200}})`

Hana (Eng-SRE): Update runbook link to https://runbooks.internal/redwood/dedicated-provisioning. Also add note: check quota ceilings if scaling stalls.

Jules (Docs): CI flagged MD013/line-length and a broken referer link to SLA. Ravi can you fix then?

Ravi (Eng-Platform): Fixed formatting and replaced SLA link with https://legal.redwood.com/sla/dedicated.pdf. Pushed 1938765420.

Ruth (Legal): Quick pass done — SLA wording consistent. Minor edit suggestion on 'reserved' definition, pinged in PR.

docs-bot: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview-489--docs.redwood.com (build passed)

Jules (Docs): Thanks everyone. I'll merge after Ruth's PR note is addressed. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
